comment: Really, really great teacher. He is always willing to help and can teach anyone, regardless of skill level. I've never painted in my life, and I did well in his intro to painting cats, but the majority of the class were skilled painters. BEWARE, you will have to buy $300ish worth of painting supplies at the beginning of the year.

TAKE ERLING! Erling is the best art teacher at Richmond. If you want to actually grow as an artist he does amazing work with helping students, but also if you simply put in any sort of effort you will do well.

A lot of expectation for an Intro course. Personal demos were more effective than group demos. He definitely loves hearing himself talk so he talks a LOT! He often wasted 20-30 mins saying things that could be said in 2-3 mins. He also has a tendency to make assumptions which can make things awkward. Though, He is caring and sensitive.

Great professor, grades you on what he believes you can do - put in effort and be ready to make commit to the class outside of lecture hours and you'll be fine. Very understanding and always available to work with you and help if needed. Even if you can't draw, he'll be patient and grade based on improvement.

Great teacher. You will definitely learn a lot from him. Great personality.He is very sensitive to individual artistic skill and he will make the effort to meet you on your level. That said, if you take his classes be prepared to take your work seriously; he expects you to make a time-commitment and to take personal pride in your work.

I had Erling for Color and Comp last semester and he is amazing. I learned so much from the class and him. I literally saw myself improve and he is so smart. Erling has a fabulous eye for color and beauty and knows exactly what he is doing at all times. Any of the classes he teaches would be worth taking!Hes a really cool and sensitive professor.

He is a cool guy, he talks alot though..i fell asleep during his lectures more than a few times. DO NOT take this class if u suck at art. He is very interesting, you will learn abt things outside of the art world. This was one of my lower grades..he is a tough tough tough grader...ugh. DO NOT use the world "realism" in his class!!!!

Erling enjoys hearing himself talk, but he knows his stuff.  I am an art major and I have loved his classes.  He also likes to say art works are "beeaaauuuuuuuuuuuuuuuutiful."  I always lol when he says that...  Anyways yeah, be ready to work for good grades but he's a very solid teacher and is very helpful.
